changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Marked the historical LTX-2 profile superseded while retaining its directly deployable immutable execution contract.
changes.details: LTX-2.5 BF16 is the current fidelity baseline and its fixed FP8-cast sequential-offload variant is the current lower-memory canary. Runtime, artifacts, build context, topology, interfaces, validation, and provenance are unchanged.

changes.summary: Restricted public build egress to hosts used during Dockerfile execution.
changes.details: Removed nvcr.io because digest-pinned base images are fetched through the separate verified base-image transfer and the build runs with pull disabled.

changes.summary: Refreshed the native distilled pipeline from LTX 1.2 to exact 1.3.0 source and its named PipelineOutput contract.
changes.details: The adapter fails closed unless ltx-pipelines is version 1.3.0 and PipelineOutput exposes video, audio, num_frames, tiling_config, keyframes, and video_latent.

changes.summary: Added the upstream-required TorchVision 0.28 and cuDNN 9.24 pins to the checksummed ARM64 source build.
Kept the declared distilled interface and conservative memory envelope while inheriting upstream decode-tiling OOM fixes.
changes.details: LTX 1.3 contains DFR and keyframe-aware decode support, but this recipe does not claim those artifact-dependent paths and remains a physical-acceptance Candidate.

changes.summary: Replaced the hidden default prompt with one required bounded UTF-8 prompt file and declared exact synchronized-MP4 output bounds.
Validate the exact H.264/AAC codec, geometry, frame rate, frame count, duration, stereo audio rate, and synchronization before atomic publication.
Resolved the spatial upscaler from the immutable runtime artifact set instead of hardcoding a companion filename.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Replaced the non-executable generic diffusers binding with the pinned official LTX 1.2 native ARM64 pipeline adapter.
Bound the exact checkpoint, Gemma 3 encoder, tokenizer, upscaler, and optional distilled LoRA files by SHA-256 without unrelated repository downloads.
Added offline synchronized audio-video MP4 generation with post-export video and audio stream verification.
Corrected the complete immutable LTX-2 snapshot and dependent disk resource sizes.
Marked the candidate as requiring a model-specific distilled synchronized video/audio adapter before acceptance.
Initial reviewed catalog release of LTX-2 19B distilled synchronized diffusers single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
